pages.text: A few copper ingots and a leather strap give your mount a steadier step in rough country.

pages.title: Sure-Footed Travel
pages.text: Hooves let a horse walk on powder snow instead of falling through, and soften fall damage - good everyday tack for mountains and cold biomes.

pages.title: Frost Walker Enchant
pages.text: Hooves take **Frost Walker** at an **Anvil** from an enchanted book. A horse running over water then leaves a trail of **frosted ice**, like a player wearing frost-walker boots.

pages.title: Built for Speed
pages.text: The ice trail keeps up with fast horses: at **15+ blocks per second** the freeze radius scales, so you can sprint across water without gaps. Lava still isn't safe.
